column1: # The exits of the bash sensors that differ from nuc's by API-sensor-cores-ask-the-shell, read by
# scripts/lib/sensor-parity.sh: a bash sensor that cannot read its input exits 1 where it measures
# nothing, and nuc sense exits 2 for every cause that keeps it from deciding
# (API-command-line-with-sense), the exception Q-2 makes for an exit an accepted ADR lists with its
# cause. One row per pair, five fields separated by tabs: the sensor; the releases it holds on,
# separated by commas, or '-' for every release; the bash's exit; nuc's exit; and the cause. A
# difference no row lists fails the harness.
